main_findings.finding: ISA 납입원금 한도 and the invested domestic equity ETF profit must be distinguished; do not claim appreciation itself consumes paid-in allowance.
KRX gold ETF capital gains can be 15.4% covered as dividend income; direct physical KRX gold-market trades different tax regime.
Adding 100 cash to 100 invested and 10 gain changes simplistic total capital return from 10% to 5%, not economic performance TWR.
3×500k buys 25+5+100 packs at prices 20k,100k,5k; effective arithmetic 1.5m/130=11,538.46.
'Automatic deposit always wins' unsupported unconditional risk-free guarantee, rejected.
16.5% pension extraordinary income tax applies only to taxable deducted premiums and investment profits on nonqualifying receipt, not all contributions.
Pension savings collateral loan issuer dependent; not universal or identical to statutory IRP restricted collateral rules.
Monthly 2.9m × 12 = 34.8m, 0.2m short of 35m goal. Original 'around 2.9m' qualification retained.
